originalTitle: Will the markov.bio AI copilot for drug discovery be influential in the R&D of a marketed drug? (Before 2030)
title: 2030 年前获批药物研发会明确归功于 markov.bio 吗？
Will a drug approved before 2030 credit markov.bio’s contribution?
rules: 药物须获 FDA 或 EMA 人用批准，并有非 markov.bio 自身的可靠材料说明该工具对早期研发有重要贡献。
A drug needs FDA/EMA human-use approval and reliable evidence outside markov.bio attributing material early-development influence to the tool.
重要贡献含关键发现、显著提速或降本；公司退出早期药物发现业务可即时 No，归因不明确保留 N/A 裁量。
Influence includes an essential discovery or substantial speed/cost improvement. Leaving early discovery can trigger No; attribution ambiguity permits N/A at creator discretion.
interpretation: 这是获批与工具贡献的联合条件，还含企业持续经营风险。计算分数、论文使用记录或 II 期临床结果均不能单独判 Yes，必须连接到具体获批分子和独立贡献说明。

This combines approval, material tool contribution and business continuity. Scores, a paper’s use of software or Phase II results alone cannot establish Yes; molecule-specific approval and external attribution are needed.

summary: 这是获批与工具贡献的联合条件，还含企业持续经营风险。计算分数、论文使用记录或 II 期临床结果均不能单独判 Yes，必须连接到具体获批分子和独立贡献说明。

This combines approval, material tool contribution and business continuity. Scores, a paper’s use of software or Phase II results alone cannot establish Yes; molecule-specific approval and external attribution are needed.
checklist: 核对获批药物、适应证和监管日期。
Match drug, indication and regulatory date.
寻找供应商之外的研发贡献说明。
Find development-contribution evidence outside the tool vendor.
保留经营终止与归因歧义条款。

stage: 计算辅助 → 实验与临床 → 批准与贡献归因
Computational assistance → experiments/trials → approval and attribution
impact: FDA 的临床阶段说明可以帮助区分实验发现、临床读数与上市批准，rentosertib 研究则提供另一项有明确分子和试验设计的实例。它们都没有验证 markov.bio 对某个药物的贡献，因此这页将企业工具归因与药物本身的证据分开，并保留原规则中的企业退出条件。

FDA’s development phases separate discovery, trial results and approval; rentosertib supplies a distinct molecule-specific study. Neither verifies markov.bio’s influence. Tool attribution and drug evidence remain separate, including the source’s business-exit condition.
gap: “显著提速/降本”没有统一量化界限，原创建者保留裁量；此曲线不是 AI 药物研发总体成功率。
Material speed/cost effects have no common numeric threshold and creator discretion remains; this is not an overall AI-discovery success rate.

title: 药物工具归因：计算结果与上市证据
Drug-tool attribution: computational results and approval
principle: 早期药物工具可能参与靶点选择、分子设计或实验排程。证明工具被使用，与证明它显著改变研发路径，需要不同材料；最后还要对应到具体分子的临床和监管结果。
Early tools may inform target selection, molecular design or experiment planning. Use and material influence require different evidence, followed by molecule-specific clinical and regulatory results.
example: 本题要求 FDA 或 EMA 批准以及来自工具供应商之外的贡献说明，也将公司退出早期发现业务列为即时 No 情形。已有 rentosertib IIa 期结果只是另一条研发实例，不证明 markov.bio 的使用、贡献或上市。

The contract requires FDA/EMA approval and contribution evidence outside the tool vendor; leaving early discovery can trigger immediate No. The separate rentosertib Phase IIa example verifies neither markov.bio involvement nor approval.

label: 贡献归因与企业退出
Attribution and business exit
detail: 重要贡献保留主观裁量，且公司退出可触发 No；不等于纯技术成功率。
Material influence remains discretionary and business exit can trigger No; this is not a pure technical-success probability.

label: 参与较少
Few participants
detail: 概率来自少量参与者；查看成交数量与原始规则。
Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.
